        fsGroup: 1000

          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
              - ALL
          privileged: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/paymentservice:v0.10.3
        ports:
        - containerPort: 50051
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "50051"
        - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
          value: "1"
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 50051
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 50051
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 1Gi
          limits:
            cpu: 120m
            memory: 1Gi
